citation: This analysis (UniProt P38157, P53338, E9P8G3, E9P8G2, E9P8G1, Q9UVH4; banded Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gaps -11/-1)
claim_tested: Mal33p/Mal13p are disabled by truncation or a frameshift-derived terminus
key_finding: Mal33p 468 aa, colinear with Mal63p; C-terminal 12 residues identical to active Mal23p and Mal23-Cp. Mal13p 473 aa, full length
context: S288C proteins vs MAL6/MAL2 locus alleles
confidence_and_limitations: High for the sequence claim; depends on the SGD/UniProt ORF calls for YBR297W and YGR288W being correct

claim_tested: A disabling change lies in the Zn(2)Cys(6) motif
key_finding: All six zinc ligands present with identical spacing in every allele tested; Gal4-equivalent base-contacting positions unchanged in Mal33p and Mal13p
confidence_and_limitations: High that no canonical motif lesion exists; does not exclude second-shell effects on affinity

claim_tested: The 2-residue deletion is the disabling change
key_finding: Mal33p's only indel, deletion of Mal63p M350-N351, is also present in the constitutive, hyperactive Mal23-Cp
confidence_and_limitations: High; gap placement within the local window is alignment-dependent but the length difference is unambiguous

claim_tested: A specific disabling substitution can be named
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; weak regional signal, small and closely related comparator set

evidence_type: Direct assay, LexA fusion deletion mapping
claim_tested: Which Mal63p regions are required
key_finding: DNA-binding domain 1-100; functional core with transactivation domain 60-283; 251-299 required to inhibit activation; remaining C-terminus is the maltose-responsive domain relieving inhibition
confidence_and_limitations: High for the domain map; defines regions, not residues

claim_tested: Truncation is a plausible inactivating mechanism
key_finding: mal64p is 85% identical to Mal63p and non-functional; the two activating mutations are nonsense codons giving 306- and 282-residue proteins; 283-470 is a maltose-responsive negative regulatory domain
confidence_and_limitations: High; inverts the direction assumed by the seed hypothesis

claim_tested: C-terminal loss would abolish activator function
key_finding: Constitutive alleles are truncations deleting 283-470, or carry many scattered C-terminal alterations; intragenic suppressors restore inducibility
confidence_and_limitations: High

claim_tested: Full-length MAL activators can be dead without truncation
key_finding: Non-inducible mal63 proteins bind Ssa1 alone and fail to associate stably with Hsp82 or Sti1; inducible Mal63p binds Ssa1, Hsp82 and Sti1 and is released by maltose
confidence_and_limitations: High for mal63 point mutants; untested for Mal33p

claim_tested: "Non-functional" MAL33 alleles are completely dead
key_finding: *S. eubayanus* QC18 *MAL33* carries frameshift and premature-stop mutations, yet overexpression of that same allele improved maltose metabolism, read as dosage-dependent transcriptional limitation
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate transferability; different species and allele, but directly undercuts inferring a dead protein from a Mal- phenotype

claim_tested: Reference length and nature of Mal63p
key_finding: Single ORF encoding 470 residues; deduced protein is a cysteine-zinc finger protein
confidence_and_limitations: High; note the derived UniProt entry P10508 is 473 aa, conflicting with the stated 470

claim_tested: MAL13 is the MAL1 counterpart of MAL63
key_finding: MAL11, MAL12, MAL13 are functionally homologous to MAL61, MAL62, MAL63
context: A strain with a **functional** MAL1 locus, not S288C
confidence_and_limitations: High for architecture; says nothing about the S288C *mal13* allele

claim_tested: MAL loci are a rapidly diverging subtelomeric family
key_finding: Five telomere-proximal complexes homologous over ~9 kb; natural mutant MAL1 and MAL3 alleles lack one or more functions through mutation and/or rearrangement
context: S. cerevisiae and S. paradoxus isolates
confidence_and_limitations: High; partial-function MAL alleles are common and arise by varied mechanisms

claim_tested: A 71%-identical MAL paralog must be a broken copy
key_finding: Subtelomeric families expand fast; duplication followed by functional divergence yields alleles metabolising different carbohydrates
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; supports a diverged-regulator reading, no direct Mal33p data

citation: This analysis (UniProt E9P8G2, E9P8G1, P38157, E9P8G3)
evidence_type: Computational, allele comparison with a functional control
claim_tested: A disabling change lies in the maltose-responsive C-terminus
key_finding: All 20 Mal23p-to-Mal23-Cp differences lie in residues 325-378; over 300-468 Mal23-Cp is 97.6% identical to Mal33p vs 88.8% to Mal23p; Mal33p 317-468 is 100% identical to Mal23-Cp
confidence_and_limitations: High for the sequence blocks; the recombination interpretation is inference from allele sequences, not a mapped crossover

claim_tested: S288C *MAL33* carries specific disabling sequence changes
key_finding: 3 of 9 natural Mal33p-class proteins are identical to the S288C reference (CEN.PK113-7D, PE-2, P301); 4 differ by 4-8 residues; all 9 are 468 aa
confidence_and_limitations: High for sequence identity. Maltose growth in these strains was not measured here and may come from other MAL loci, so this shows absence of an S288C-specific change, not that Mal33p is active

citation: This analysis (AlphaFold DB v6; phenix.superpose_pdbs and Kabsch fitting)
claim_tested: A fold-level defect explains non-function
key_finding: Zn(2)Cys(6) RMSD 0.09-0.30 A in all alleles; residues 1-100 RMSD 15.87 A for Mal33p but 11.09 A for the functional Mal23-Cp; per-domain pLDDT within 4 points across alleles
confidence_and_limitations: Structure prediction is non-discriminating here; the functional control is what makes the negative interpretable

citation: QuickGO annotation records for P38157, P53338, P10508, Q06595
claim_tested: Existing GO annotations are independent support for Mal33p activity
key_finding: All three manual Mal33p annotations (GO:0003700, GO:0006355, GO:0005634) are ISS with with/from SGD:S000029659 (*MAL63*), reference PMID:10447589, the Mal63p paper. GO:0000978 and GO:0045944 are not on the entry. Mal13p carries GO:0005975 by IMP from PMID:3025617
confidence_and_limitations: High for the annotation state. The ISS calls are defensible on sequence grounds but are circular as evidence that Mal33p is equivalent to Mal63p

citation: This analysis (GenBank AF003003 flatfile, M36537, X12576; UniProt E9P8G3, P10508)
claim_tested: That E9P8G3 is wild-type Mal63p
key_finding: AF003003 is `/allele="mal63-13"`, `/note="nonfunctional mutant allele of MAL63"`; UniProt submitted name "Mal63-13p". M36537 translates to 470 aa, matching PMID 3145816; X12576 to 473 aa, the source of P10508
context: Corrects rounds one and two of this report
confidence_and_limitations: High for the record contents. Impact bounded: mal63-13 is 98.5% identical to wild type, so all identity figures shift by under 1 point

citation: This analysis (M36537, E9P8G3, E9P8G2, E9P8G1, Q9UVH4, P38157, P53338; Needleman-Wunsch, identity scoring)
claim_tested: Mal33p carries the changes that disable a MAL activator
key_finding: At positions 355, 357, 358, 364 the three functional alleles carry N, N, N, E and both non-functional alleles carry S, S, S, K. Mal33p and Mal13p carry N, N, N, E. The block lies inside 325-378, the inducible-to-constitutive window of *MAL23*
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Perfect separation but only 3 versus 2 alleles (Fisher exact floor p = 0.1), and the two non-functional alleles are not phylogenetically independent

citation: This analysis (identity to wild-type Mal63p, M36537)
claim_tested: 71% identity to Mal63p implies a broken copy
key_finding: Dead mal63-13p 98.5%, dead mal64p 85.5%, hyperactive Mal23-Cp 91.2%, Mal33p 71.6%, Mal13p 72.0%
confidence_and_limitations: High. Identity and function are uncorrelated across this allele set

citation: SGD locus and phenotype records for YBR297W and YGR288W; PMID 24721214; PMID 7483839
claim_tested: "Nonfunctional in genomic reference strain S288C" rests on an activity measurement
key_finding: MAL33's three SGD primary references (PMID 2548922, PMID 2549370, PMID 7483839) are locus-structure and genome-sequencing papers with no activity assay. SGD records "utilization of carbon source: decreased rate" for *MAL33* in strain S288C from PMID 24721214. Feuermann 1995 reports the three *MAL3* ORFs intact and excludes telomeric silencing
confidence_and_limitations: High for the record contents; the deletion phenotype is from a systematic screen and was not independently confirmed here

claim_tested: What a genuinely disabled MAL activator looks like
key_finding: "Two naturally occurring inactive alleles of MAL1 show a deletion or divergence of their MALR sequences"; the MAL3 locus carries a repeat of more than 10 kb giving four copies of MAL3R-homologous sequence
confidence_and_limitations: High. The MAL3 repeat structure is a reason to check which *MAL33*-homologous copy S288C YBR297W corresponds to

claim_tested: MAL33 and MAL13 are non-functional in S288C
key_finding: Both annotated "MAL-activator protein; part of complex locus MAL3 (MAL1); nonfunctional in genomic reference strain S288C", qualifier Verified
confidence_and_limitations: Database-level only; states the phenotype, not the molecular cause
